seoTitle: How to Link Payment Processors on Squarespace: Easy Guide
metaDescription: Connect Stripe, PayPal, or Square to your Squarespace store through Commerce settings so you can accept secure payments from customers.
intro: Whether you're running an online store, selling digital products, or taking bookings, you need a working payment processor connected before customers can check out. This guide walks through accessing Squarespace's Commerce settings and linking Stripe, PayPal, or Square.

steps.heading: Access Commerce settings
steps.body: From your site dashboard, open the Commerce section where payment options are managed.

steps.heading: Choose a payment processor
steps.body: Decide between Stripe, PayPal, or Square based on your business needs and where you operate.

steps.heading: Connect Stripe for card payments
steps.body: Link your Stripe account to accept credit and debit card payments directly through your Squarespace checkout.

steps.heading: Link PayPal for extra options
steps.body: Add PayPal alongside Stripe to give customers more ways to pay at checkout.

steps.heading: Test transactions and finalize
steps.body: Run a test transaction, enable multiple currencies if needed, and confirm your checkout process works smoothly before going live.

faq.question: Can I use more than one payment processor at once?
faq.answer: Yes, you can connect Stripe and PayPal together so customers have multiple ways to pay at checkout.

faq.question: Is Square available for all Squarespace stores?
faq.answer: Square payments are available depending on your region, so check availability in your Commerce settings.

faq.question: How do I make sure payments actually work before launch?
faq.answer: Run a test transaction after connecting your processor to confirm the checkout flow completes correctly.

faq.question: Can I accept payments in multiple currencies?
faq.answer: Yes, Squarespace Commerce settings allow you to enable multiple currencies for international customers.
